title: The Last Terminal
author: Noor Whitlock
blurb: Zephyrine Lockridge, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
